Its omission of household, contractor, tips, strike and Medicaid pay agrees with the project, which now computes them (lines 1b, 1c, 1d, 1g, 1h). Triage (pass 4be1d7385eb3): 4,207/4,499 agree; 34 value differences, all on refused returns; 212 project-unknown on incomplete/refused partial records; 46 candidate-unknown (34 completed: scope.excess_deferral read without its W-2 gate). Ruling: interface gap; the pages do not define this helper, the union of the other-income and return-treatment screens that refuse. Every screen refuses through one of the two helpers, so no return differs in whether it is refused. Re-reviewed because scope.fiscal_year was added (i1040gi p. 12, Fiscal-year filers). Project stands.
